# Oversized rule file

This file exists only to push the corpus past a small test budget, so the
loader's truncation path is exercised with a real file rather than a stub.
It sorts last on purpose: the loader walks alphabetically, so the two useful
rule files are loaded first and this one is the file that gets dropped.
